types.name: Nuclear plant
types.description: Every nuclear power plant in service (powerplantmatching): Almaraz, Ascó, Cofrentes, Vandellós and Trillo. Value is the plant's capacity; retired plants (Garoña, Zorita, Vandellós I) are not shown.

types.name: Hydroelectric dam
types.description: Hydro plants (reservoir or run-of-river) of at least 200 MW. Plants of this type in one hex are summed and shown as one site.

types.name: Coal power plant
types.description: Coal plants of at least 500 MW not yet retired in powerplantmatching. Plants of this type in one hex are summed and shown as one site.

types.name: Gas power plant
types.description: Gas plants (mostly combined cycle) of at least 750 MW. Plants of this type in one hex are summed and shown as one site.

types.name: Oil-fired power plant
types.description: Fuel-oil and diesel plants of at least 150 MW: the island grids (Canary Islands from OpenStreetMap, the Balearics, Ceuta and Melilla). Plants of this type in one hex are summed and shown as one site.

types.name: Pumped-storage hydro
types.description: Pumped-storage plants of at least 400 MW: grid batteries made of two reservoirs. Plants of this type in one hex are summed and shown as one site.

types.name: Wind farms
types.description: Wind capacity, shown where a hex totals at least 150 MW. Plants of this type in one hex are summed and shown as one site.

types.name: Solar farms
types.description: Solar capacity (photovoltaic and solar thermal), shown where a hex totals at least 150 MW (rooftop solar is not included). Plants of this type in one hex are summed and shown as one site.

types.name: Battery storage
types.description: Battery-storage capacity, shown where a hex totals at least 50 MW. Plants of this type in one hex are summed and shown as one site.
